question: What enduring quality makes the practice dear to the yoginīs?
premises: The subject possesses splendor equal to the rising sun
This quality is described as eternal
This quality is dear to the yoginīs
inference: The practice or reality in question is eternally radiant like the rising sun and beloved of the yoginīs
uncertainties: The exact substantive qualified by the compound adjectives is implicit
plain_english: It is eternally radiant like the rising sun and indeed dear to the yoginīs.
